Drift Rush: Stunt Park

Drift Rush: Stunt Park

About Drift Rush: Stunt Park

Slide chunky toy cars through a sunny city and a desert stunt park. Chain long drifts, launch off giant ramps, spin in the air and smash cones to build huge combos. Clear 24 levels, earn coins and unlock six cars with upgrades and paint jobs, or cruise in free roam.

How to play

A D or Arrows steer Space DRIFT button hold to drift W Up accelerate S Down brake On phones the car drives itself hold the left or right side of the screen to steer
